steps.name: Defer circuit enforcement to merge queue
steps.run: echo "Known failure circuits are enforced against the synthetic merge-group base."

steps.name: Evaluate merge-group circuit hold
steps.run:
node ./scripts/release-health-merge-group-failure-signatures.mjs \
  --command guard \
  --lane merge-group \
  --base-sha "${{ github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}" \
  --candidate-sha "${{ github.event.merge_group.head_sha }}" \
  --actor "${{ github.triggering_actor }}" \
  --automatic false \
  --enforcement "$DELIVERY_FAILURE_CIRCUIT_ENFORCEMENT" \
  --github-summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Resolve changed surface
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
  base="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
  head="${{ github.sha }}"
elif [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "merge_group" ]; then
  base="${{ github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}"
  head="${{ github.event.merge_group.head_sha }}"
else
  base="${{ github.event.before }}"
  head="${{ github.sha }}"
fi

if [ -z "$head" ]; then
  head="${{ github.sha }}"
fi
if [ -z "$base" ]; then
  base="$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
fi

if [[ "$base" =~ ^0+$ ]]; then
  base="$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 "$head")"
fi

first_parent=""
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ] || [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "merge_group" ]; then
  first_parent="--first-parent"
fi

node ./scripts/change-scope.mjs github-output --base="${base}" --head="${head}" $first_parent

steps.name: Raise PostgreSQL lock table capacity for DB Profile
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

# The eight-file bootstrap DB partition runs with bounded
# --maxWorkers=3, so up to ~3 x ~20 concurrent multi-context pools
# each cascade-drop their schemas in beforeEach. max_locks_per_transaction
# is a postmaster-start parameter: ALTER SYSTEM only stages the
# change, the shared lock table isn't resized until the postmaster
# restarts (a reload/SIGHUP is not sufficient), so this restarts the
# service container and confirms the effective setting before any
# DB-profile command runs.
target_max_locks_per_transaction=512
# 300 is bounded headroom, not an observed hosted peak. Workspace
# concurrency stays 2; pools allocate clients on demand, not at max.
target_max_connections=300

free -m
docker inspect --format 'Memory={{.HostConfig.Memory}} MemorySwap={{.HostConfig.MemorySwap}} ShmSize={{.HostConfig.ShmSize}} (bytes; Memory=0 means no Docker limit)' "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID"
docker exec "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID" sh -c '
  for setting in /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.high /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes; do
    if [ -r "$setting" ]; then printf "%s=" "$setting"; cat "$setting"; fi
  done'

docker exec "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID" psql -U postgres -c \
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_locks_per_transaction = ${target_max_locks_per_transaction};"
docker exec "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID" psql -U postgres -c \
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_connections = ${target_max_connections};"
docker restart "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID"

ready=false
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  if docker exec "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID" pg_isready -U postgres -d postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ready=true
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$ready" != "true" ]; then
  echo "PostgreSQL did not become ready within 30s after restart." >&2
  docker logs "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID" >&2 || true
  exit 1
fi

effective="$(docker exec "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID" psql -U postgres -tAc 'SHOW max_locks_per_transaction;' | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [ "$effective" != "$target_max_locks_per_transaction" ]; then
  echo "Expected max_locks_per_transaction=${target_max_locks_per_transaction} but Postgres reports ${effective}." >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "PostgreSQL max_locks_per_transaction is now ${effective}."

effective="$(docker exec "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID" psql -U postgres -tAc 'SHOW max_connections;' | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [ "$effective" != "$target_max_connections" ]; then
  echo "Expected max_connections=${target_max_connections} but Postgres reports ${effective}." >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "PostgreSQL max_connections is now ${effective}."
docker exec "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID" psql -U postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c \
  'SHOW max_connections; SHOW max_locks_per_transaction; SHOW shared_buffers; SHOW work_mem; SHOW maintenance_work_mem; SHOW superuser_reserved_connections; SHOW reserved_connections;'

steps.name: Upload bootstrap DB evidence including failures
Capture post-failure PostgreSQL state
steps.run:
mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/db-profile-diagnostics"
{
  echo 'Post-failure observation only; not failure-instant or peak attribution.'
  date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  timeout 15s docker exec "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID" psql -U postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c \
    'SHOW max_connections; SHOW max_locks_per_transaction; SHOW shared_buffers; SHOW work_mem; SHOW maintenance_work_mem; SHOW superuser_reserved_connections; SHOW reserved_connections;' || echo 'PostgreSQL settings unavailable.'
  timeout 15s docker exec "$POSTGRES_CONTAINER_ID" psql -U postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c \
    'SELECT datname, application_name, state, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 4 DESC;' || echo 'PostgreSQL activity unavailable.'
} > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/db-profile-diagnostics/post-failure.txt" 2>&1

steps.name: Prove three synthetic Chromium capture cases
Capture responsive evidence checkout identity
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
checkout_commit="$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}')"
checkout_tree="$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{tree}')"
checkout_parents="$(git show -s --diff-merges=off --format=%P HEAD)"
executed_base_sha="$(printf '%s\n' "$checkout_parents" | awk '{print $1}')"
executed_base_tree="$(git rev-parse --verify "${executed_base_sha}^{tree}")"
source_head_tree="$(git rev-parse --verify "${RESPONSIVE_EVIDENCE_SOURCE_HEAD_SHA}^{tree}")"
{
  echo "checkout-commit=${checkout_commit}"
  echo "checkout-tree=${checkout_tree}"
  echo "checkout-parents=${checkout_parents}"
  echo "executed-base-sha=${executed_base_sha}"
  echo "executed-base-tree=${executed_base_tree}"
  echo "source-head-tree=${source_head_tree}"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Verify required jobs
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

require_job() {
  local name="$1"
  local result="$2"
  local required="$3"

  if [ "$required" != "true" ] && [ "$required" != "false" ]; then
    echo "${name} has unknown or missing gate-plan requirement '${required}'." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  if [ "$required" = "true" ]; then
    if [ "$result" != "success" ]; then
      echo "${name} was required but finished with result '${result}'." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return
  fi

  if [ "$result" != "skipped" ] && [ "$result" != "success" ]; then
    echo "${name} was not required but finished with unexpected result '${result}'." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

require_job "Known Failure Guard" "${{ needs['known-failure-guard'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.known_failure_guard_required }}"
require_job "Change Scope" "${{ needs['change-scope'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.change_scope_required }}"
require_job "Static Checks" "${{ needs.static.result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.static_required }}"
require_job "Typecheck" "${{ needs.typecheck.result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.typecheck_required }}"
require_job "Unit Tests" "${{ needs['unit-tests'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.unit_tests_required }}"
require_job "DB Profile Tests" "${{ needs['db-tests'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.db_tests_required }}"
require_job "E2E Tests" "${{ needs['e2e-tests'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.e2e_tests_required }}"
capture_required="$(node --input-type=module -e '
const required = process.env.AC4_E2E_REQUIRED;
const suites = JSON.parse(process.env.AC4_E2E_SUITES_JSON);
if (!["true", "false"].includes(required) || !Array.isArray(suites) ||
    suites.some(suite => typeof suite !== "string" || suite.length === 0)) {
  throw new Error("Capture Hermetic Chromium has unknown or missing selection");
}
console.log(required === "true" && suites.includes("tcgplayer_connector_extension"));
')"
require_job "Capture Hermetic Chromium" "${{ needs['capture-hermetic-chromium'].result }}" "$capture_required"
require_job "Build" "${{ needs.build.result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.build_required }}"
require_job "Docker Image Build" "${{ needs['docker-image'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.docker_image_required }}"
require_job "Workflow Lint" "${{ needs['workflow-lint'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.workflow_lint_required }}"
require_job "Terraform Preview Plan" "${{ needs['terraform-preview-plan'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.terraform_preview_plan_required }}"
require_job "Terraform Staging Plan" "${{ needs['terraform-staging-plan'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.terraform_staging_plan_required }}"
require_job "Terraform Production Plan" "${{ needs['terraform-production-plan'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.terraform_production_plan_required }}"
require_job "Terraform Observability Plan" "${{ needs['terraform-observability-plan'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.terraform_observability_plan_required }}"
require_job "Deploy Preview and Smoke" "${{ needs['preview-deploy-smoke'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.preview_deploy_smoke_required }}"
require_job "Compose Boot Smoke" "${{ needs['compose-preview-smoke'].result }}" "${{ needs['change-scope'].outputs.compose_preview_smoke_required }}"

steps.name: Update PR release status comment
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
comment_id="$(
  gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/comments" \
    --jq '.[] | select(.user.login == "github-actions[bot]" and (.body | contains("<!-- chase-sets-pr-release-status -->"))) | .id' | tail -n 1
)"
if [ -n "$comment_id" ]; then
  gh api --method PATCH "repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" \
    -f body="$(cat artifacts/pr-release-status.md)" >/dev/null
else
  gh api --method POST "repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/comments" \
    -f body="$(cat artifacts/pr-release-status.md)" >/dev/null
fi
